LanguageData.RP_CountsDesc: How many times a day the guards walk the wings and count heads (none to four; at lockup and at six by default). Each wing takes a guard half an hour at most; with no guard free in the hour the count is missed. An escape nobody saw - no guard, camera or tower had the runaway in sight - is not known until a count finds the cell empty, and every hour of it counts against getting them back. Counts are at {0}. With counts off an escape is known the moment it happens.
